summary_1line: In the dice-hall, Duryodhana taunts Draupadi and the Pandavas; Bhima vows vengeance after Karna insults her and Duryodhana exposes his thigh.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi stands in the royal assembly weeping and pleading while rows of silent kings avert their eyes as Duryodhana smirks from his throne.
Bhima, arms raised like iron maces and eyes blazing with fury, restrains himself while the elders urge him to forbear in the crowded hall.
Duryodhana provocatively bares his powerful thigh before Draupadi as Bhima glares and swears to shatter it in a future battle.
